name: Pettah study area (approximate bounding box)
source: Same bbox as the project's OpenStreetMap road snapshot (docs/data-sources.md, retrieved 12 October 2026). Manually reviewed: it contains all six mapped Pettah shopping streets in src/data/street-locations.json. No authoritative Pettah boundary has been adopted.
notes: Approximate only. Records outside are flagged out_of_area and cannot be published. Edges may clip parts of Pettah or include fringes of Fort/Kotahena; review before enlarging.
